arr.title: FitRise
arr.subtitle: Fitness Website
arr.description:
A cloud-connected step, water intake, and sleep tracker that adjusts the user's daily goals based on the previous day's performance. Includes a friends system, rewards system, and role-based security.
Guest account login available upon selecting 'Login.'
role: Sole backend developer as part of a team

arr.title: Fists of Fate
arr.subtitle: Fighting Game
arr.description: A 2.5D fighting game. Includes a computer-controlled player in addition to standard human local multiplayer. Coded in a designer-friendly fashion for quick and easy changes to character data.

arr.title: Drum Game Clone
arr.subtitle: Rhythm Game
arr.description: A Python clone of the rhythm game Taiko no Tatsujin.

arr.title: Game Store
arr.subtitle: Ecommerce Site Mockup
arr.description: A video game-centered ecommerce website mockup. A static website created using vanilla HTML, CSS, and JS. It's complete with screen reader accessibility and mobile responsiveness.

arr.title: Game Store React
arr.subtitle: Ecommerce Site Remake
arr.description: A port of my previous Game Store project, a static website, to React. Utilizes MirageJS to emulate API requests. Has a 'Debug' option that lets you simulate a slow or broken connection to the server.

arr.title: Unity Cutscene System
arr.description:
A designer-friendly cutscene system for Unity allowing for non-programmers to easily create cutscenes.
Uses Unity's built-in Timeline system for the cinematics, and uses a custom dialogue system for conversations and cutscene routing. Dialogue dynamically parsed from JSON.
